notes.title: Biggest Xenos Demo Update to Date!
notes.content:
Added:

[list]
[*] Day and Night Cycle - A day and night cycle based on your devices time. Sun will rise and set and at night street lights will kick on to light the way. Battle background also changes after dark.
[*] Character Creation - Choose your name and select from 7 avatars to represent you.
[*] Nick Naming - You can now give a nick name to any Xeno you capture. Some creature catchers may nick name their Xenos as well.
[*] 20 new moves added
[*] A whole host of bug and balance fixes
[*] 1 new Xeno added
[*] Palette swaps added to variant Xenos.
[/list]

Now is a better time than ever to hop into the demo! Give it a shot!

notes.title: Huge Demo Update Live Now!
notes.content:
I have just dropped the a complete overhaul of the original demo. There are more moves, graphical and audio settings, many quality of life updates, updated Xenos models, and so much more! If you haven't already, please give the demo a shot and let me know what you think. If you have already, please revisit. Its like a brand new game!

Known issues:

[list]
[*] Too many graphical settings options in graphics settings menu
[*] Some moves are missing a sound effect or have unbalanced sound volume.
[*] Status effect placement is off on some Xenos.
[*] Using all of your items can slow down bag scrolling.
[/list]

I plan on putting out a couple more small updates to this demo in the coming weeks, then on to full release!

notes.title: Updated Demo Coming soon!
notes.content:
Xenos will be receiving an updated demo later this month or early June (still working out the exact time frame. The game has undergone some huge changes.  Including:

[list]
[*] Battles are now 2.5D with animated characters.
[*] Ui has been updated.
[*] Battle system has been updated (statuses now stack, variant forms have been updated, there are now 5 Xeno types that can be exploited by certain moves)
[*] Graphic and sound settings have been added.
[*] Weather has been added to the overworld
[*] There are more than double the moves than were in the original demo.
[/list]  

I cant wait to show you the big changes and I hope everyone gets a chance to try it. Thank you for reading and a huge thanks to anyone who has wish listed or tried the demo. It means a ton!

notes.title: Alpha tester branch update, demo will be uneffected
notes.content: In order to show off some new features during the nextfest stream, I will be updating the build for the early alpha I sent out to a few streamers and friends. This will likely not effect anyone reading this as the demo version is not effected. If you are playing the alpha version provided by a steam key, do not update your game if you wish to finish your playthrough. This update will break saves due to a big change in the way statuses are handled.

notes.title: A couple of features are still in the oven!
notes.content:
After the NextFest please drop back in to the demo if you like what you played! Two more features have been implemented and are currently in bug testing. Those features are

[list]
[*]Stacking statuses - Right now a lot of moves apply status, but you can only have one at a time. I decided to go a more traditional rpg route with statuses instead of the traditional pet battler style and statuses now stack.
[*]Fast Travel - I have gotten a lot of feedback on how long it takes to get back to a healer and I hear you on that! Fast travel to the last healer you used has been added and will also be pushed out in a patch after NextFest once it has been thoroughly bug tested.

Why should you care? Well 1) The game definitely feels a bit more strategic with the stacking statuses. And 2) It is going to break saves. I wanted to avoid this as much as possible, but the stacking statuses will break saves. To be as transparent as possible, the save data that stores statuses stored a single status because that is all you could ever have at once. Now that save data had to be converted to a list of statuses and any old saves will fail to have save data for that list. I apologize if this is inconvenient for anyone, but I am not pushing the update until after NextFest so everyone has a chance to complete any playthrough they may be on!
[/list]

- Base battle speed is 25% faster (Recomended by JenjibobCries)

- Added animations based on attack strength (more to come but implemented a few for the demo)

- Fixed message not showing when using a healing item, making it seem like the game soft locked (found on anarky's stream)

- Added the ability to pet the cat in the house in the first town (recommended by Anarky and his viewers)
